# r3v3rs3

> A reverse proxy server with a built-in WebUI for TCP, UDP, TLS, HTTP, WebSocket and HTTP/3, written in Rust. It is a fork of Taxy.

r3v3rs3 runs as a single binary or a single container. You configure it in a browser, not in a configuration file: every port, proxy, certificate and account is a form in the WebUI, and the same operations are available over an admin API. It can also build its proxies from Docker labels, a Kubernetes Ingress, the Consul catalog, the Consul key-value store or etcd keys.

The documentation is published in English at the root and in Turkish under `/tr/`. Every page listed below has a Turkish translation at the same path with the `/tr/` prefix.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/): what r3v3rs3 does and the feature list
- [Configuration](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/configuration/): every port and proxy field, with its default
- [Accounts](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/accounts/): the roles, the permissions and the proxy list of a panel account
- [Service Discovery](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/discovery/): Docker, Kubernetes, Consul and etcd sources
- [Cluster](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/cluster/): the cluster settings, the store keys, the encryption and the failure modes
- [Deployment Platform](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/platform/): deploy container images, roll back and route their domains
- [Development](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/development/): build the server and the WebUI from source

## Tutorials

- [Installing on a Linux Server](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/install-linux/): install as a systemd service with install.sh
- [Installing with Docker](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/install-docker/): one container with two volumes
- [Getting Started](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/getting-started/): from the first account to the first working proxy
- [High Availability](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/high-availability/): three nodes behind a load balancer
- [Proxies from Docker](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/docker-discovery/): let containers define their own proxies with labels
- [HTTPS with a Wildcard Certificate](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/https-certificates/): DNS-01, renewal and HTTP/3
- [Protecting an Application](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/protect-an-app/): IP filter, authentication, rate limit and audit log
- [Caching and Compression](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/cache-and-compression/): answer repeated requests from memory and send smaller responses
- [TCP and UDP Proxies](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/tcp-and-udp/): publish a database over TCP and a DNS server over UDP, with mutual TLS
- [r3v3rs3 on Kubernetes](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/kubernetes/): Ingress and R3v3rs3Proxy resources
- [Load Balancing and Health Checks](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/load-balancing/): weights, health checks, sticky sessions, WebSocket and gRPC
- [Driving r3v3rs3 from a Script](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/admin-api/): sign in to the admin API and drive it from CI
- [Proxies from Consul and etcd](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/consul-etcd-discovery/): the Consul catalog, the Consul key-value store and etcd keys
- [Accounts for a Team](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/team-accounts/): per-person proxies, TOTP and the audit log
- [Single Sign-On with Forward Auth](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/forward-auth/): oauth2-proxy in front of an application
- [Migrating from nginx or Traefik](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/migrate/): translate the configuration and cut over

## Source and packages

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/KilimcininKorOglu/r3v3rs3)
- [crates.io: r3v3rs3](https://crates.io/crates/r3v3rs3): the server binary
- [crates.io: r3v3rs3-api](https://crates.io/crates/r3v3rs3-api): the shared API types
- [docs.rs: r3v3rs3-api](https://docs.rs/r3v3rs3-api): the API type reference
- [Container image](https://github.com/KilimcininKorOglu/r3v3rs3/pkgs/container/r3v3rs3): `ghcr.io/kilimcininkoroglu/r3v3rs3`
